baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257. It features two fan speeds and a variable temperature control dial and is rated at 1500 watts. The main components are a plastic molded housing that encompasses a heating element, motor-fan assembly, power switch and power cord. It delivers hot air for heat shrinking, stripping paint, bending plastic, drying and thawing. The Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The main housing, front cover and heating element are produced in Thailand. The electric motor, fan, motor support, printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), switch, power cord, wiring, knob, back cover and support ring, heat insulator and fasteners are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: press fit the fan to the motor spindle and attach the fan cover; crimp plugs to the heating element wires, add heat shrink tubing, solder wires to the switch and plug the heating element into the switch and PCBA; fasten the PCBA to the main housing, assemble the temperature knob, connect the PCBA to the motor, add the back cover and motor support; secure the power cord, add the switch slider, close the housing with screws, test, label and pack.

key_factors: Heating element and main housing manufactured in Thailand combined with final assembly
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the heating element and main housing, along with final assembly of all components in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: The essential character of a heat gun is to generate and direct intense heat. The heating element (the core heat-generating component) and the main housing/front cover are manufactured in Thailand. Although the motor, fan, and PCBA are sourced from China, the production of the key heating element and housings in Thailand, combined with the integration and electrical assembly of all subcomponents into a finished tool in Thailand, constitutes a substantial transformation conferring Thai origin.

plans.description: Make Motor-fan assembly and Switch, cord and minor parts in Thailand
plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257. It features two fan speeds and a variable temperature control dial and is rated at 1500 watts. The main components are a plastic molded housing that encompasses a heating element, motor-fan assembly, power switch and power cord. It delivers hot air for heat shrinking, stripping paint, bending plastic, drying and thawing. The Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The main housing, front cover, heating element, electric motor, fan, motor support, switch, power cord, wiring, knob, back cover and support ring, heat insulator and fasteners are produced in Thailand. The printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) are sourced from China. 

In Thailand, the electric motor, fan and motor support will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle.

In Thailand, the switch, power cord, wiring, knob, back cover and support ring, heat insulator and fasteners will be produced in-house: make the switch, power cord, wiring, supports and fasteners.

Final assembly in Thailand: press fit the fan to the motor spindle and attach the fan cover; crimp plugs to the heating element wires, add heat shrink tubing, solder wires to the switch and plug the heating element into the switch and PCBA; fasten the PCBA to the main housing, assemble the temperature knob, connect the PCBA to the motor, add the back cover and motor support; secure the power cord, add the switch slider, close the housing with screws, test, label and pack.

key_factors: Heating element, electric motor, and fan assembly
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the motor, heating element, fan, and housing, plus final assembly in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: Nearly all major components of the heat gun—including the heating element, electric motor (built from stamped laminations and wound rotors), fan, switch, and housing—are manufactured in Thailand. Only the PCBA is sourced from China. Similar to N351782, where the country producing the motor and fan blades conferred origin, the functional components imparting the essential character (heating element and motor-fan assembly) are made and assembled in Thailand, resulting in a substantial transformation there.

verdict.reasoning: In closely analogous fan-forced heating appliances (N347421, N345859), CBP holds that the heating element, electric motor, fan, and switches/power cord collectively impart the essential identity and functionality of the device. In Variant A, although the housing and heating element are made in Thailand, the motor, fan, PCBA, switch, and power cord come from China, making China the country of origin. In Variant B, production of the motor (from stamping laminations and winding the rotor), fan, switch, power cord, and virtually all other parts shifts to Thailand, leaving only the PCBA from China. Under N347421, origin shifts to Thailand.
